constraints.name: valid_pair_definition
constraints.description: A pair of indices {i, j} with i != j is considered valid if a[i] + a[j] > 0. The pair is unordered, meaning {i, j} and {j, i} are the same pair and counted only once.
constraints.formal: For i ≠ j, pair {i, j} is valid if and only if a[i] + a[j] > 0; each unordered pair is counted exactly once.
